1088            kwargs (dict): Additional keyword arguments.
1089
1090        Returns:
1091            Self: The canvas object.
1092        Examples:
1093            >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1094            >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1095            >>> triangle = sg.Shape([(0, 0), (40, 0), (40, 40)], closed=True)
1096            >>> canvas.draw(triangle, fill_color=sg.blue, pos=(40, 0))
1097            Canvas()
1098            >>> scaled = sg.Canvas()
1099            >>> scaled.draw(sg.Shape([(0, 0), (10, 0)]), scale=2)
1100            Canvas()
1101            >>> scaled.active_page.sketches[0].vertices[1]
1102            (20.0, 0.0)
1103            >>> labeled = sg.Canvas()
1104            >>> labeled.draw(triangle, indices=True, midpoints=True) is labeled
1105            True
1106            >>> sg.prepare_shape_index_labels(labeled.active_page.sketches[0])[1]
1107            [0, 1, 2, 'e0', 'e1', 'e2']
1108            >>> labeled.active_page.sketches[1].vertices
1109            [(20.0, 0.0), (40.0, 20.0), (20.0, 20.0)]
1110            >>> labeled.active_page.sketches[1].marker_size
1111            1.0
1112            >>> coordinates = sg.Canvas()
1113            >>> coordinates.draw(triangle, vertices=True, midpoints=True) is coordinates
1114            True
1115            >>> sg.prepare_shape_vertex_coord_labels(coordinates.active_page.sketches[0])[1]
1116            ['(0.0, 0.0)', '(40.0, 0.0)', '(40.0, 40.0)', '(20.0, 0.0)', '(40.0, 20.0)', '(20.0, 20.0)']
1117        """
1118        warn_unknown_kwargs(
1119            kwargs,
1120            get_draw_valid_kwargs(),
1121            context="canvas.draw",
1122            stacklevel=3,
1123        )
1124        if not item_s:
1125            raise TypeError("Canvas.draw() requires at least one item")
1126        if len(item_s) == 1 and isinstance(item_s[0], (list, tuple)):
1127            items = item_s[0]
1128        else:
1129            items = item_s
1130
1131        if midpoints:
1132            kwargs["midpoints"] = midpoints
1133        if isinstance(scale, (int, float)):
1134            scale = (float(scale), float(scale))
1135
1136        base_sketch_xform = self._sketch_xform_matrix
1137
1138        try:
1139            for item in items:
1140                if item is matplotlib_pyplot:
1141                    item = _matplotlib_plot_image(close_fig=close_fig)
1142
1143                sketch_xform = base_sketch_xform
1144                if pos is not None:
1145                    mid_x, mid_y = item.midpoint[:2]
1146                    dest_x, dest_y = pos[:2]
1147                    dx = dest_x - mid_x
1148                    dy = dest_y - mid_y
1149                    sketch_xform = translation_matrix(dx, dy) @ sketch_xform
1150                if scale[0] != 1 or scale[1] != 1:
1151                    sketch_xform = (
1152                        scale_in_place_matrix(*scale[:2], about) @ sketch_xform
1153                    )
1154                if angle != 0:
1155                    sketch_xform = (
1156                        rotation_matrix(angle, rotocenter) @ sketch_xform
1157                    )
1158                self._sketch_xform_matrix = self._xform_matrix @ sketch_xform
1159                draw.draw(
1160                    self,
1161                    item,
1162                    draw_items=items,
1163                    draw_pos=pos,
1164                    **kwargs,
1165                )
1166        finally:
1167            self._sketch_xform_matrix = identity_matrix()
1168        if show:
1169            self.display()
1170        else:
1171            return self

Draw the item_s. Pass items individually or as one sequence.

Arguments:
  • *item_s (Drawable | Sequence): Item(s) to draw. Passing matplotlib.pyplot snapshots its current figure as an image. Use draw(a, b) or draw([a, b]). A Vector is drawn as a line with an arrow head from the origin to (x, y). vec_start places the tail; vec_end places the tip. If both are omitted, the tail is at the origin. Only one is needed. If both are given and match the Vector, a warning is issued; if they disagree, ValueError is raised. Several Vectors in one call share the same vec_start or vec_end. shaft_line_color / shaft_line_dash_array / shaft_line_width style the shaft; head_fill_color / head_line_color / head_line_width style the head; color and alpha style both. A Dimension uses those arrow names for its dimension line, ext_line_alpha / ext_line_color / ext_line_dash_array / ext_line_width for both extension lines, and tag_bold / tag_fill / tag_fill_color / tag_font_alpha / tag_font_color / tag_font_family / tag_font_size / tag_line_color / tag_line_width / tag_stroke for the label. tag_stroke defaults to False. color and alpha set every part; a prefixed name wins. An AnnotationArrow uses the same shaft, head, and tag names. Shaft style covers the angled shaft and the landing. Its tag_stroke stays as it is unless given: False for a note, True for a balloon.
  • pos (PointType, optional): Midpoint where the item is drawn. For a group, this is the group's midpoint; every member is shifted by the same (dx, dy). The item is not moved. Defaults to None.
  • angle (float, optional): The angle to rotate the item(s), defaults to 0.
  • rotocenter (PointType, optional): The point about which to rotate, defaults to (0, 0).
  • scale (tuple, optional): The scale factors for the x and y axes, defaults to (1, 1).
  • about (tuple, optional): The point about which to scale, defaults to (0, 0).
  • show (bool, optional): If True, draws the canvas in a Jupyter cell.
  • midpoints (bool, optional): With vertices=True, label edge midpoint coordinates as well as vertex coordinates. With indices=True, draw circles of radius 1 point at edge midpoints and label them e0, e1, ... in edge order. Both flags show both kinds of midpoint labels. Closed shapes include the closing edge. Midpoint labels use the same positioning and overlap avoidance as vertex labels. Defaults to False.
  • close_fig: Close the active Matplotlib figure after draw(plt) snapshots it. Defaults to True. Set False to keep editing or draw the same figure again.
  • filter (SVG_Filter, optional): SVG filter object to apply to the drawn item(s).
  • kwargs (dict): Additional keyword arguments.
Returns:

Self: The canvas object.

Examples:

>>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
>>> triangle = sg.Shape([(0, 0), (40, 0), (40, 40)], closed=True)

Canvas()
>>> scaled = sg.Canvas()

Canvas()
>>> scaled.active_page.sketches[0].vertices[1]
(20.0, 0.0)

>>> labeled.draw(triangle, indices=True, midpoints=True) is labeled
True
>>> sg.prepare_shape_index_labels(labeled.active_page.sketches[0])[1]
[0, 1, 2, 'e0', 'e1', 'e2']
>>> labeled.active_page.sketches[1].vertices
[(20.0, 0.0), (40.0, 20.0), (20.0, 20.0)]
>>> labeled.active_page.sketches[1].marker_size
1.0
>>> coordinates = sg.Canvas()
>>> coordinates.draw(triangle, vertices=True, midpoints=True) is coordinates
True
>>> sg.prepare_shape_vertex_coord_labels(coordinates.active_page.sketches[0])[1]
['(0.0, 0.0)', '(40.0, 0.0)', '(40.0, 40.0)', '(20.0, 0.0)', '(40.0, 20.0)', '(20.0, 20.0)']

Draw the lace object.

Lace-specific options belong here, not on canvas.draw. Generic shape styles in kwargs are forwarded to fragment and plait draws.

Arguments:
  • lace: Lace object to be drawn.
  • fragment_coloring: Color equivalent fragments by area, or by distance from the lace center.
  • plait_style: Plait drawing style. None uses filled plaits.
  • shade_plaits: Shade embossed or diamond plaits.
  • fillet_radii: (inner, outer) fillet radii. None does not fillet.
  • palette: Fragment color palette.
  • swatch: Overrides palette when given.
  • plait_color: Fill color for plaits.
  • draw_fragments: Draw fragment regions.
  • draw_plaits: Draw plaits.
  • percent_offsets: Inner-line positions for PlaitStyle.INNERLINES.
  • line_widths: Inner-line widths for PlaitStyle.INNERLINES.
  • **kwargs: Generic shape style overrides.
Returns:

Self: The canvas object.

Examples:
>>> import simetri.graphics as sg
>>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
>>> lace = sg.Lace(
... sg.Group(

... ).scale(2),
... offset=12,
... )
>>> canvas.draw_lace(lace)
Canvas()

['SHAPE_SKETCH', 'SHAPE_SKETCH', 'SHAPE_SKETCH', 'SHAPE_SKETCH', 'SHAPE_SKETCH', 'SHAPE_SKETCH', 'SHAPE_SKETCH', 'SHAPE_SKETCH', 'SHAPE_SKETCH']
>>> moved = sg.Canvas()
>>> with moved.translate(220, 0):
...     _ = moved.draw_lace(lace)
>>> round(
...     moved.active_page.sketches[0].vertices[0][0]
...     - canvas.active_page.sketches[0].vertices[0][0]
... )
220
>>> via_draw = sg.Canvas()
>>> with via_draw.translate(220, 0):
...     _ = via_draw.draw(lace)
>>> round(
...     via_draw.active_page.sketches[0].vertices[0][0]

... )

def group_graph( self, group: simetri.group.batch.Group) -> networkx.classes.digraph.DiGraph: 
1891    def group_graph(self, group: "Group") -> nx.DiGraph:
1892        """
1893        Return a directed graph of the group and its elements.
1894        Canvas is the root of the graph.
1895        Graph nodes are the ids of the elements.
1896
1897        Args:
1898            group (Group): The group to create the graph from.
1899
1900        Returns:
1901            nx.DiGraph: The directed graph of the group and its elements.
1902        Examples:
1903            >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1904            >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1905            >>> group = sg.Group([sg.Circle(40)])
1906            >>> graph = canvas.group_graph(group)
1907            >>> graph.number_of_nodes()
1908            3
1909            >>> graph.number_of_edges()
1910            2
1911            >>> list(graph.successors(canvas.id))
1912            [group.id]
1913            >>> list(graph.successors(group.id))
1914            [group.elements[0].id]
1915        """
1916
1917        def add_group(group: Group, graph: nx.DiGraph) -> nx.DiGraph:
1918            """Recursively register ``group`` and its elements on ``graph``.
1919
1920            Examples:
1921                Called from ``group_graph`` for nested groups.
1922            """
1923            graph.add_node(group.id)
1924            for item in group.elements:
1925                graph.add_edge(group.id, item.id)
1926                if item.subtype == Types.GROUP:
1927                    add_group(item, graph)
1928            return graph
1929
1930        di_graph = nx.DiGraph()
1931        di_graph.add_edge(self.id, group.id)
1932        for item in group.elements:
1933            if item.subtype == Types.GROUP:
1934                di_graph.add_edge(group.id, item.id)
1935                add_group(item, di_graph)
1936            else:
1937                di_graph.add_edge(group.id, item.id)
1938
1939        return di_graph

Return a directed graph of the group and its elements. Canvas is the root of the graph. Graph nodes are the ids of the elements.

Arguments:
  • group (Group): The group to create the graph from.
Returns:

nx.DiGraph: The directed graph of the group and its elements.

Examples:
>>> import simetri.graphics as sg
>>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
>>> group = sg.Group([sg.Circle(40)])
>>> graph = canvas.group_graph(group)
>>> graph.number_of_nodes()
3
>>> graph.number_of_edges()
2
>>> list(graph.successors(canvas.id))
[group.id]
>>> list(graph.successors(group.id))
[group.elements[0].id]

1942        self,
1943        pos: tuple[float, float] | None = None,
1944        width: float | None = None,

1946        spacing: float | None = None,

1951        """
1952        Draw help lines on the canvas.
1953
1954        When ``pos``, ``width``, and ``height`` are omitted, the grid is
1955        clipped to the canvas background at save time and does not
1956        change the canvas size. ``deferred=False`` uses the current
1957        canvas frame.
1958
1959        Args:
1960            pos (tuple): The lower-left corner of the grid.
1961            width (float): The length of the help lines along the x-axis.
1962            height (float): The length of the help lines along the y-axis.
1963            spacing (int): The spacing between the help lines.
1964            cs_size (float): The size of the coordinate system.
1965            kwargs (dict): Additional keyword arguments.
1966
1967        Returns:
1968            Self: The canvas object.
1969        Examples:
1970            >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
1971            >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
1972            >>> canvas.help_lines((0, 0), 20, 20, spacing=40, cs_size=0, deferred=False)
1973            Canvas()
1974            >>> [tuple(sketch.vertices) for sketch in canvas.active_page.sketches]
1975            [((0.0, 40.0), (20.0, 40.0)), ((40.0, 0.0), (40.0, 20.0))]
1976        """
1977        if spacing is None:
1978            spacing = defaults["help_lines_spacing"]
1979        if cs_size is None:
1980            cs_size = defaults["CS_size"]
1981        if pos is not None or width is not None or height is not None:
1982            if pos is None:
1983                margin = defaults["help_lines_margin"]
1984                pos = (-margin, -margin)
1985            if width is None:
1986                width = defaults["help_lines_width"]
1987            if height is None:
1988                height = defaults["help_lines_height"]
1989
1990        draw.help_lines(
1991            self, pos, width, height, spacing, cs_size, deferred, **kwargs
1992        )
1993
1994        return self

2132    def new_page(self, **kwargs: object) -> Self:
2133        """Create a new page and append it to ``pages``.
2134
2135        Args:

2137
2138        Returns:
2139            Self: The canvas object.

2141            >>> import simetri.graphics as sg

2143            >>> first = canvas.active_page
2144            >>> canvas.new_page()
2145            Canvas()
2146            >>> canvas.active_page is canvas.pages[1]
2147            True
2148            >>> canvas.active_page is first
2149            False
2150        """
2151        recto = not self.active_page.recto
2152        page_margins = self.margins
2153        if self.book_margins is not None:
2154            gutter, footer, margin, header = self.book_margins
2155            if recto:
2156                page_margins = (gutter, footer, margin, header)
2157            else:
2158                page_margins = (margin, footer, gutter, header)
2159
2160        page = Page(
2161            size=self.page_size,
2162            back_color=self.back_color,
2163            border=self.border,
2164            margins=page_margins,
2165            book_margins=self.book_margins,
2166            recto=recto,
2167        )
2168        self.pages.append(page)
2169        self.active_page = page
2170        for k, v in kwargs.items():
2171            setattr(page, k, v)
2172        if page.book_margins is not None:
2173            gutter, footer, margin, header = page.book_margins
2174            if page.recto:
2175                page.margins = (gutter, footer, margin, header)
2176            else:
2177                page.margins = (margin, footer, gutter, header)
2178        self.__dict__["margins"] = page.margins
2179        self.__dict__["book_margins"] = page.book_margins
2180        return self

2462    ) -> Self:
2463        """
2464        Draw a rectangle.

2647    def resolve_property(self, item: Drawable, property_name: str) -> Any:
2648        """Resolve a property from the item, then ``defaults``.
2649
2650        Does **not** apply ``canvas.draw`` kwargs or the canvas style overlay.
2651        For full draw-time precedence (kwargs → overlay → item → defaults),
2652        use ``resolve_style_properties``.
2653
2654        Args:
2655            item: Drawable whose attribute is read when not ``None``.
2656            property_name: Style field name.

2659            Any: ``getattr(item, name)`` or the configured default when unset.
2660
2661        Examples:
2662            >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
2663            >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
2664            >>> circle = sg.Circle(40)
2665            >>> circle.line_width = 3
2666            >>> canvas.resolve_property(circle, 'line_width')
2667            3
2668        """
2669        value = getattr(item, property_name, None)
2670        if value is None:
2671            value = runtime_defaults.get(property_name, VOID)
2672            if value == VOID and property_name not in ("color", "alpha"):
2673                issue_warning(
2674                    f"Property {property_name} is not in defaults.",
2675                    warning_type=WarningType.canvas.missing_default,
2676                )
2677                value = None
2678        return value

2681        self,
2682        item: Drawable,
2683        style_map: dict[str, str],
2684        **draw_kwargs: object,
2685    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
2686        """Resolve style values for sketch creation in one place.
2687
2688        Precedence per key (see ``ground_rules.md``): draw kwargs, then
2689        canvas style overlay (``layered``), then ``resolve_property`` (item,
2690        then defaults). Color and alpha fan-out are handled before the
2691        style-map loop.
2692
2693        Examples:
2694            >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
2695            >>> from simetri.render.style_map import shape_style_map
2696            >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
2697            >>> shape = sg.Shape([(0, 0), (40, 0), (40, 40)], closed=True)
2698            >>> shape.line_width = 3
2699            >>> resolved = canvas.resolve_style_properties(shape, shape_style_map)
2700            >>> resolved['line_width']
2701            3
2702        """
2703        overlay = self._style_overlay
2704
2705        def layered(name: str) -> tuple[bool, Any]:
2706            """Return whether ``name`` is set in kwargs or canvas style overlay.
2707
2708            Examples:
2709                Used by ``resolve_style_properties`` for kwargs and overlay.
2710            """
2711            if name in draw_kwargs:
2712                return True, draw_kwargs[name]
2713            if name in overlay:
2714                return True, overlay[name]
2715            return False, None
2716
2717        d_resolved = {}
2718        resolved = []
2719        # handle color
2720        color = None
2721        found_color, color_value = layered("color")
2722        found_line_color, line_color_value = layered("line_color")
2723        found_fill_color, fill_color_value = layered("fill_color")
2724        if found_color:
2725            if check_color(color_value):
2726                d_resolved["color"] = color_value
2727                resolved.append("color")
2728                if not found_line_color:
2729                    d_resolved["line_color"] = color_value
2730                    resolved.append("line_color")
2731                if not found_fill_color:
2732                    d_resolved["fill_color"] = color_value
2733                    resolved.append("fill_color")
2734            else:
2735                raise ValueError(f"Invalid color value: {color_value}")
2736        else:
2737            item_color = getattr(item, "color", None)
2738            if item_color is not None:
2739                if check_color(item_color):
2740                    color = item_color
2741                else:
2742                    raise ValueError(f"Invalid color value: {item_color}")
2743
2744        if found_line_color:
2745            d_resolved["line_color"] = line_color_value
2746            if "line_color" not in resolved:
2747                resolved.append("line_color")
2748        if found_fill_color:
2749            d_resolved["fill_color"] = fill_color_value
2750            if "fill_color" not in resolved:
2751                resolved.append("fill_color")
2752
2753        if color is not None:
2754            if "line_color" not in resolved:
2755                if item.line_color is None:
2756                    d_resolved["line_color"] = color
2757                else:
2758                    d_resolved["line_color"] = item.line_color
2759                resolved.append("line_color")
2760            if "fill_color" not in resolved:
2761                if item.fill_color is None:
2762                    d_resolved["fill_color"] = color
2763                else:
2764                    d_resolved["fill_color"] = item.fill_color
2765                resolved.append("fill_color")
2766            if "color" not in resolved:
2767                resolved.append("color")
2768
2769        # handle alpha
2770        alpha = None
2771        found_alpha, alpha_value = layered("alpha")
2772        found_line_alpha, line_alpha_value = layered("line_alpha")
2773        found_fill_alpha, fill_alpha_value = layered("fill_alpha")
2774        if found_alpha:
2775            if check_alpha(alpha_value):
2776                d_resolved["alpha"] = alpha_value
2777                resolved.append("alpha")
2778                if not found_line_alpha:
2779                    d_resolved["line_alpha"] = alpha_value
2780                    resolved.append("line_alpha")
2781                if not found_fill_alpha:
2782                    d_resolved["fill_alpha"] = alpha_value
2783                    resolved.append("fill_alpha")
2784            else:
2785                raise ValueError(f"Invalid alpha value: {alpha_value}")
2786        else:
2787            item_alpha = getattr(item, "alpha", None)
2788            if item_alpha is not None:
2789                if check_alpha(item_alpha):
2790                    alpha = item_alpha
2791                else:
2792                    raise ValueError(f"Invalid alpha value: {item_alpha}")
2793
2794        if found_line_alpha:
2795            d_resolved["line_alpha"] = line_alpha_value
2796            if "line_alpha" not in resolved:
2797                resolved.append("line_alpha")
2798        if found_fill_alpha:
2799            d_resolved["fill_alpha"] = fill_alpha_value
2800            if "fill_alpha" not in resolved:
2801                resolved.append("fill_alpha")
2802
2803        if alpha is not None:
2804            if "line_alpha" not in resolved:
2805                if item.line_alpha is None:
2806                    d_resolved["line_alpha"] = alpha
2807                else:
2808                    d_resolved["line_alpha"] = item.line_alpha
2809                resolved.append("line_alpha")
2810            if "fill_alpha" not in resolved:
2811                if item.fill_alpha is None:
2812                    d_resolved["fill_alpha"] = alpha
2813                else:
2814                    d_resolved["fill_alpha"] = item.fill_alpha
2815                resolved.append("fill_alpha")
2816            if "alpha" not in resolved:
2817                resolved.append("alpha")
2818
2819        for attrib_name in style_map:
2820            if attrib_name in resolved:
2821                continue
2822            found_layer, layer_value = layered(attrib_name)
2823            if found_layer:
2824                d_resolved[attrib_name] = layer_value
2825            else:
2826                d_resolved[attrib_name] = self.resolve_property(
2827                    item, attrib_name
2828                )
2829            resolved.append(attrib_name)
2830
2831        return d_resolved

Resolve style values for sketch creation in one place.

Precedence per key (see ground_rules.md): draw kwargs, then canvas style overlay (layered), then resolve_property (item, then defaults). Color and alpha fan-out are handled before the style-map loop.

Examples:
>>> import simetri.graphics as sg
>>> from simetri.render.style_map import shape_style_map
>>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
>>> shape = sg.Shape([(0, 0), (40, 0), (40, 40)], closed=True)

def save( self, filepath: pathlib.Path, overwrite: bool | None = None, show: bool | None = None, print_output: bool = False, remove_aux: bool = True, inset: float | None = None, display: bool = False) -> Self: 
2859    def save(
2860        self,
2861        filepath: Path,
2862        overwrite: bool | None = None,
2863        show: bool | None = None,
2864        print_output: bool = False,
2865        remove_aux: bool = True,
2866        inset: float | None = None,
2867        display: bool = False,
2868    ) -> Self:
2869        """Save the canvas to a file.
2870
2871        Args:
2872            filepath: Output path.
2873            overwrite: Whether to overwrite an existing file.
2874            show: Whether to open the file after save (uses ``[viewer]`` config).
2875            print_output: Print compiler output when saving TeX-backed formats.
2876            remove_aux: Remove auxiliary TeX files after PDF generation.
2877            inset: Clip this margin from all sides before export.
2878            display: Show the canvas in a notebook after save.
2879
2880        Returns:
2881            Self: The canvas object.
2882        Examples:
2883            >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
2884            >>> import tempfile
2885            >>> from pathlib import Path
2886            >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
2887            >>> _ = canvas.draw(sg.Circle(40))
2888            >>> path = Path(tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.svg')[1])
2889            >>> canvas.save(path, overwrite=True, show=False)
2890            Canvas()
2891            >>> path.exists()
2892            True
2893        """
2894
2895        if inset is not None:
2896            self.inset = inset
2897
2898        self._vertex_label_sizing_warned = False
2899        self._warn_sketches_outside_page()
2900
2901        filepath = resolve_save_filepath(filepath)
2902        parent_dir, file_name, extension = validate_output_filepath(
2903            filepath, overwrite
2904        )
2905
2906        if (
2907            extension not in native_save_extensions()
2908            and converter_supports_extension(extension)
2909        ):
2910            converter = get_converter_for_extension(extension)
2911            source_extension = f".{converter['source']}"
2912            intermediate_path = os.path.join(
2913                parent_dir, f".{file_name}.simetri_src{source_extension}"
2914            )
2915            try:
2916                self.save(
2917                    intermediate_path,
2918                    overwrite=True,
2919                    show=False,
2920                    print_output=print_output,
2921                    remove_aux=remove_aux,
2922                    inset=None,
2923                    display=False,
2924                )
2925                run_external_converter(
2926                    input_path=intermediate_path,
2927                    output_path=filepath,
2928                    extension=extension,
2929                )
2930            finally:
2931                if os.path.isfile(intermediate_path):
2932                    os.remove(intermediate_path)
2933            self._show_browser(
2934                filepath=filepath, show_browser=show, multi_page_svg=False
2935            )
2936            return self
2937
2938        renderer = _save_renderer(extension)
2939        multi_page_svg = False
2940        if renderer == Renderer.SVG:
2941            from simetri.render.render_svg.svg import get_svg_code
2942
2943            if len(self.pages) > 1:
2944                multi_page_svg = True
2945                active_page = self.active_page
2946                for i, page in enumerate(self.pages):
2947                    self.active_page = page
2948                    page_filepath = os.path.join(
2949                        parent_dir, f"{file_name}_{i + 1}{extension}"
2950                    )
2951                    validate_output_filepath(page_filepath, overwrite)
2952                    svg_code = get_svg_code(self)
2953                    with open(page_filepath, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
2954                        f.write(svg_code)
2955                self.active_page = active_page
2956            else:
2957                svg_code = get_svg_code(self)
2958                with open(filepath, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
2959                    f.write(svg_code)
2960        else:
2961            image_paths, generated_image_paths = _materialize_tex_image_assets(
2962                self, parent_dir, file_name
2963            )
2964            try:
2965                tex_code = get_tex_code(self, image_paths=image_paths)
2966                tex_path = os.path.join(parent_dir, file_name + ".tex")
2967                with open(tex_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
2968                    f.write(tex_code)
2969                if extension == ".tex":
2970                    return self
2971
2972                run_job(parent_dir, file_name, extension, tex_path)
2973                if remove_aux:
2974                    remove_aux_files(filepath)
2975            finally:
2976                if extension != ".tex":
2977                    for image_path in generated_image_paths:
2978                        if os.path.isfile(image_path):
2979                            os.remove(image_path)
2980
2981        self._show_browser(
2982            filepath=filepath, show_browser=show, multi_page_svg=multi_page_svg
2983        )
2984        return self

def style( self, mapping: Any = None, **kwargs: object) -> simetri.render.canvas._CanvasScope: 
3142    def style(self, mapping: Any = None, **kwargs: object) -> _CanvasScope:
3143        """Apply a canvas style overlay and return a restore-on-``with`` scope.
3144
3145        Bare call leaves the overlay on. ``with canvas.style(...)`` restores
3146        the overlay from entry. Does not mutate drawables.
3147
3148        Args:
3149            mapping: A ``Style``, a dict of draw aliases, or omitted.
3150            **kwargs: Draw-alias overlay; overwrites ``mapping`` for those keys.
3151        Examples:
3152            >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
3153            >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
3154            >>> scope = canvas.style(line_width=2)
3155            >>> scope._kind
3156            'style'
3157            >>> canvas._style_overlay
3158            {'line_width': 2}
3159        """
3160        if mapping is None and not kwargs:
3161            raise TypeError(
3162                "canvas.style() requires a Style, a dict, or keyword arguments"
3163            )
3164        overlay = coerce_style_overlay(mapping, kwargs)
3165        saved = dict(self._style_overlay)
3166        for key, value in overlay.items():
3167            if value is None:
3168                if key in self._style_overlay:
3169                    del self._style_overlay[key]
3170            else:
3171                self._style_overlay[key] = value
3172        return _CanvasScope(self, "style", saved)

def translate(self, dx: float, dy: float) -> simetri.render.canvas._CanvasScope: 
3312    def translate(self, dx: float, dy: float) -> _CanvasScope:
3313        """
3314        Translate the canvas by dx and dy.
3315
3316        Bare call leaves the translation on. ``with canvas.translate(dx, dy)``
3317        restores the matrix from entry.
3318
3319        Args:
3320            dx (float): The translation distance along the x-axis.
3321            dy (float): The translation distance along the y-axis.
3322
3323        Returns:
3324            A scope that restores the matrix when used as a context manager.
3325        Examples:
3326            >>> import simetri.graphics as sg
3327            >>> canvas = sg.Canvas()
3328            >>> scope = canvas.translate(60, 80)
3329            >>> scope._kind
3330            'matrix'
3331            >>> canvas.pos
3332            [60.0, 80.0]
3333        """
3334        saved = self._xform_matrix.copy()
3335        self._xform_matrix = translation_matrix(dx, dy) @ self._xform_matrix
3336        return _CanvasScope(self, "matrix", saved)
